name: Making the Night Hers
source:
Brooke, a werewolf, is new in the town of Gravesborough, where she just started her freshman year of college. One night as the moon rises, she hides herself in the woods to wait out her transformation in peace.

But when she returns to human form, her clothes are missing!

With no other choice than to sneak back to her dorm in her birthday suit, Brooke starts a daring streak across town. But to her surprise, she's not alone! Out on the Gravesborough streets, she runs into quite a few more cute girls than she expected! And they're all more than happy to spend time with her, clothing be damned.

[From [url=https://dumbsuccubus.itch.io/making-the-night-hers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
狼人少女布鲁克初来格雷夫斯伯勒镇，刚刚开启自己的大学一年级生活。某天夜晚明月升起时，她独自躲进树林深处，打算安安静静地熬过变身之夜。

谁知等她变回人形时，衣服竟然不翼而飞了！

别无选择的布鲁克只能赤身裸体偷偷摸回宿舍，就此踏上了一场横穿小镇的大胆裸奔之旅。但令她意外的是，街上并非空无一人！在格雷夫斯伯勒的夜色街头，她撞见的可爱女孩远比预想中多得多——而且她们个个都乐意与她共度良宵，穿没穿衣服根本无所谓。

[摘自[url=https://dumbsuccubus.itch.io/making-the-night-hers]itch.io[/url]]
